h1: 해커스 어법 제대로 CHAPTER 04 · p.52-53 어법변형문제 정답 및 해설

groups.bar: p.52-53 정답 및 해설 (수능 대비 제대로)
groups.quick:
빠른정답
1) was → were / 2) takes → take / 3) did played → did play / 4) is → does / 5) should tell → should have told

items.pre: Among all my students
items.post: several truly gifted musicians like him.
items.correct: Among all my students were several truly gifted musicians like him.
items.badge: 도치된 주어와 동사의 수일치 (Chapter 01 POINT 6)
items.explain: Among all my students(내 모든 학생들 중에)라는 부사구가 문두에 나오면서 주어와 동사가 도치된 구조이다. 진짜 주어는 뒤에 나오는 복수명사 several truly gifted musicians이므로 동사도 복수형이어야 한다. 따라서 was가 아니라 were가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: His parents suggested that he
items.post: lessons, but he preferred to teach himself.
items.correct: His parents suggested that he take lessons, but he preferred to teach himself.
items.badge: 주장·제안·요구·명령 동사 뒤 that절의 should 생략 (Chapter 04 POINT 2)
items.explain: suggest처럼 제안을 나타내는 동사 뒤 that절이 당위성을 나타낼 때는 동사가 「(should) + 동사원형」이 되어야 한다. 따라서 takes가 아니라 take가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: The boy never learned the piano in class, but he really
items.correct: The boy never learned the piano in class, but he really did play well nevertheless.
items.badge: 일반동사의 의미를 강조하는 do동사 (Chapter 04 POINT 4)
items.explain: 일반동사의 의미를 강조할 때는 「do/does/did + 동사원형」의 형태를 써야 한다. 따라서 did 뒤에는 과거형 played가 아니라 동사원형 play가 와야 한다.

items.pre: I don't know if the little boy plays the piano on stage now, but I hope he
items.correct: I don't know if the little boy plays the piano on stage now, but I hope he does.
items.badge: 반복되는 동사 대신 쓰는 do/be/have동사 (Chapter 04 POINT 3)
items.explain: 앞에 나온 일반동사 plays를 대신하려면 be동사가 아니라 do동사를 써야 한다. 따라서 is가 아니라 does가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: I didn't say anything to him then, but sometimes I think I
items.post: him to keep playing the piano.
items.correct: I didn't say anything to him then, but sometimes I think I should have told him to keep playing the piano.
items.badge: 조동사 뒤 동사원형 vs. have p.p. (Chapter 04 POINT 1)
items.explain: 이미 지나가버린 과거의 일(그때 말하지 않은 것)에 대한 후회를 나타내므로 조동사 뒤에는 동사원형이 아니라 「have p.p.」가 와야 한다. 따라서 should tell이 아니라 should have told가 되어야 한다.

groups.bar: p.52-53 정답 및 해설 (수능 대비 제대로)
groups.quick:
빠른정답
1) have → are / 2) do believed → do believe / 3) must have banned → must ban / 4) them → those / 5) understood → understand

items.pre: Many students and parents think that phones in the classroom aren't a problem, but a large number of schoolteachers think that they
items.correct: Many students and parents think that phones in the classroom aren't a problem, but a large number of schoolteachers think that they are.
items.badge: 반복되는 동사 대신 쓰는 do/be/have동사 (Chapter 04 POINT 3)
items.explain: 앞에 나온 be동사 aren't를 대신하려면 do동사나 have동사가 아니라 be동사를 써야 한다. 따라서 have가 아니라 are가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: Many teachers
items.post: that phone use directly lowers students' focus in class.
items.correct: Many teachers do believe that phone use directly lowers students' focus in class.
items.badge: 일반동사의 의미를 강조하는 do동사 (Chapter 04 POINT 4)
items.explain: 일반동사의 의미를 강조할 때는 「do/does/did + 동사원형」의 형태를 써야 한다. 따라서 do 뒤에는 believed가 아니라 동사원형 believe가 와야 한다.

items.pre: They said that the government
items.post: the use of phones in the classroom and pointed at a recent report by experts.
items.correct: They said that the government must ban the use of phones in the classroom and pointed at a recent report by experts.
items.badge: 조동사 뒤 동사원형 vs. have p.p. (Chapter 04 POINT 1)
items.explain: 이는 정부가 앞으로 반드시 해야 할 일에 대한 현재의 강한 필요성을 나타내므로 must 뒤에는 have p.p.가 아니라 동사원형이 와야 한다. 따라서 must have banned가 아니라 must ban이 되어야 한다.

items.pre: The safety risks of phone use are far greater than
items.correct: The safety risks of phone use are far greater than those of other classroom distractions.
items.badge: it/them vs. that/those (Chapter 11 POINT 3)
items.explain: 앞에 나온 복수명사 risks를 대신하면서 of 이하의 수식을 받으려면 목적격 대명사 them이 아니라 지시대명사 those를 써야 한다. 따라서 them이 아니라 those가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: The schoolteachers suggested that the government
items.post: the importance of this issue and try to persuade students and parents.
items.correct: The schoolteachers suggested that the government understand the importance of this issue and try to persuade students and parents.
items.badge: 주장·제안·요구·명령 동사 뒤 that절의 should 생략 (Chapter 04 POINT 2)
items.explain: suggest처럼 제안을 나타내는 동사 뒤 that절이 당위성을 나타낼 때는 동사가 「(should) + 동사원형」이 되어야 한다. 따라서 understood가 아니라 understand가 되어야 한다.

groups.bar: p.52-53 정답 및 해설 (수능 대비 제대로)
groups.quick:
빠른정답
1) trains → train / 2) have → did / 3) dedicated → was dedicated / 4) amazing → amazed / 5) should have considered → should consider

items.pre: Her supervisor recommended that she
items.correct: Her supervisor recommended that she train new recruits in flight safety.
items.badge: 주장·제안·요구·명령 동사 뒤 that절의 should 생략 (Chapter 04 POINT 2)
items.explain: recommend처럼 권고를 나타내는 동사 뒤 that절이 당위성을 나타낼 때는 동사가 「(should) + 동사원형」이 되어야 한다. 따라서 trains가 아니라 train이 되어야 한다.

items.pre: Many other nurses admired her courage, and some
items.post: too, even decades after her death.
items.correct: Many other nurses admired her courage, and some did too, even decades after her death.
items.badge: 반복되는 동사 대신 쓰는 do/be/have동사 (Chapter 04 POINT 3)
items.explain: 앞에 나온 일반동사 admired를 대신하려면 have동사가 아니라 do동사를 써야 한다. 따라서 have가 아니라 did가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: In recognition of her achievements, several aviation organizations honored her with awards, and a memorial
items.correct: In recognition of her achievements, several aviation organizations honored her with awards, and a memorial was dedicated in her hometown years later.
items.badge: 능동태 vs. 수동태 (Chapter 03 POINT 1)
items.explain: a memorial(기념비)은 누군가에 의해 '헌정되는' 대상이므로 능동태가 아니라 수동태로 써야 한다. 따라서 dedicated가 아니라 was dedicated가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: Her story continues to inspire nursing students today, many of whom feel
items.post: when they learn about her achievements.
items.correct: Her story continues to inspire nursing students today, many of whom feel amazed when they learn about her achievements.
items.badge: 감정동사의 현재분사 vs. 과거분사 (Chapter 07 POINT 4)
items.explain: 학생들(many of whom)은 감동을 '느끼는' 주체이므로 감정을 유발하는 능동의 현재분사가 아니라 감정을 느끼는 수동의 과거분사가 쓰여야 한다. 따라서 amazing이 아니라 amazed가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: Today's young people hoping to become nurses
items.post: the example set by Ms. Church.
items.correct: Today's young people hoping to become nurses should consider the example set by Ms. Church.
items.badge: 조동사 뒤 동사원형 vs. have p.p. (Chapter 04 POINT 1)
items.explain: 오늘날의 젊은이들에게 하는 현재 시점의 일반적인 조언이므로 조동사 뒤에는 have p.p.가 아니라 동사원형이 와야 한다. 따라서 should have considered가 아니라 should consider가 되어야 한다.

groups.bar: p.52-53 정답 및 해설 (수능 대비 제대로)
groups.quick:
빠른정답
1) than most other CEOs → than that of most other CEOs / 2) were → did / 3) why did he never listen → why he never listened / 4) must felt → must have felt / 5) did believed → did believe

items.pre: His management style was harsher
items.to: than that of most other CEOs
items.correct: His management style was harsher than that of most other CEOs, according to former employees.
items.badge: 비교구문 관련 표현 (Chapter 13 POINT 3)
items.explain: 비교 대상은 같은 종류여야 하므로 his management style(경영 스타일)은 CEOs(사람)가 아니라 '다른 CEO들의 경영 스타일'과 비교되어야 한다. 따라서 앞에 나온 명사 style을 대신하는 that을 사용해 than that of most other CEOs로 고쳐야 한다.

items.pre: He never showed his employees the same amount of respect that they
items.correct: He never showed his employees the same amount of respect that they did to him.
items.badge: 반복되는 동사 대신 쓰는 do/be/have동사 (Chapter 04 POINT 3)
items.explain: 앞에 나온 일반동사 showed를 대신하려면 be동사가 아니라 do동사를 써야 한다. 따라서 were가 아니라 did가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: Employees often wondered
items.correct: Employees often wondered why he never listened to feedback.
items.badge: 간접의문문의 어순 (Chapter 14 POINT 3)
items.explain: wondered의 목적어로 쓰인 간접의문문은 「의문사 + 주어 + 동사」의 평서문 어순을 따라야 한다. 따라서 의문문 어순인 why did he never listen이 아니라 why he never listened로 고쳐야 한다.

items.pre: Looking back, he
items.post: regret for treating his staff so poorly.
items.correct: Looking back, he must have felt regret for treating his staff so poorly.
items.badge: 조동사 뒤 동사원형 vs. have p.p. (Chapter 04 POINT 1)
items.explain: 이미 벌어진 과거의 일에 대한 강한 추측을 나타내므로 must 뒤에는 동사원형이 아니라 「have p.p.」가 와야 한다. 따라서 must felt가 아니라 must have felt가 되어야 한다.

items.pre: He
items.post: his approach was effective, even as morale dropped.
items.correct: He did believe his approach was effective, even as morale dropped.
items.badge: 일반동사의 의미를 강조하는 do동사 (Chapter 04 POINT 4)
items.explain: 일반동사의 의미를 강조할 때는 「do/does/did + 동사원형」의 형태를 써야 한다. 따라서 did 뒤에는 과거형 believed가 아니라 동사원형 believe가 와야 한다.
